insert into merchant_subscription (merchant_id, subscription_type, start_date, end_date, max_usage, used_count, is_active, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{subscriptionType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{maxUsage}, 0, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update start_date = least(coalesce(start_date, values(start_date)), values(start_date)), end_date = greatest(coalesce(end_date, values(end_date)), values(end_date)), max_usage = coalesce(max_usage, 0) + coalesce(values(max_usage), 0), is_active = 1, update_time = now()
